name: ask-page
title: AskPage
description: Ask about the page on screen. The answer streams in grounded in its text, with tap-to-jump quotes and follow-ups, and says when the page does not hold it.

budget.strategy: The whole page in one streamed pass when it fits; otherwise the chunks that best match the question, in page order. Quotes are checked against the page and dropped when they are not in it.
